payload.title: Votes, ratings and karma
payload.description:
Reader and editor signals on items. Decisions (2026-10-21): an upvote is separate from the 1-5 dimension ratings; karma is needed. The way editor and reader scores combine is an open exploration (see the score combination epic), so this epic stores both signals separately and tallies each.

Parent initiative: PPY-77bb3b (milestones 3 and 4). Depends on reader accounts. Pilot: Shipped, voting story ship-b35fa2 (dimensions real, useful, notable, novel are publication data, never code).

Children: upvote and vote model; dimension ratings with histograms; minimum-n rules and derived values; karma model.
Definition of Done: signed-in readers can upvote and rate; tallies are produced per item with editor and reader values separate; karma is computed and shown.
